# DEPARTMENTS The civil administration works from the Administration office, with desks wherever the colony's work is done. Office hours are 0800 to 1800, colony time. Out of hours, leave a comment under the notices; the duty clerk reads them at the start of shift.
## Office of the Administrator - The Colony Administrator and the Deputy Administrator. - Ordinances, petitions, appointments, curfew passes and liaison with the colony's charter holders.
## Atmosphere and Safety - Runs the air monitors, gas alarms and the siren network. - Issues rebreathers and inspects the seals on homes and workplaces. Report a failed seal or a strange smell at once.
## Claims and Works - Registers mining claims and work sites, and holds every ground survey on file. - Inspectors may halt any excavation or works without notice.
## Food and Stores - Oversees hydroponics, greenhouses, cold stores and food reserves. - Ration schedules are posted here when reserves fall below quota.
## Housing and Public Works - Roads, water, power and housing. Seegson runs the assignment desk under contract: [netlink="housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Public Records - Births, deaths, marriages, residency papers and work permits. - Every resident may inspect their own file on request.
## Garrison Liaison - Coordinates with the garrison on patrols, curfews and emergency response. Garrison orders are published at [netlink="Garrison Command" link="command.govfor.mil"].
## Public Information - Press releases and statements go to [netlink="The Colony Herald" link="herald.colony.news"] and colony radio.
